banner.headline: The dance platform that helps do the work—not just track it.
banner.support: DanceFlow connects the business side of dance with the dancers and experiences that make the community grow.

studios.headline: Run the studio without chasing the details.
studios.support: DanceFlow keeps scheduling, clients, packages, payments and paperwork connected, and points out what needs your attention next.
studios.cta: See plans and start your trial

blocks.title: Run the day-to-day
blocks.body: The work that fills a studio week, in one connected place.
bullets: Private lessons, group classes and intro lessons on one schedule
Client records, packages and memberships you set up once
Card payments through Stripe and e-signature waivers tracked from sent to signed

blocks.title: See what needs attention
blocks.body: ARIA, DanceFlow's operations assistant, looks across your studio for things like packages nearing renewal, pending booking requests and unsigned documents, then suggests the next step.
bullets: You choose how much it does on its own. Billing, access and refund decisions always stay with you.

blocks.title: Be found by the dancers looking for you
blocks.body: Your public studio profile can appear in Discover, where dancers search by place and style, and its inquiry form turns interest into intro lesson requests you can follow up on.

instructors.headline: Run your teaching business, not a pile of spreadsheets.
instructors.support: If you teach on your own, DanceFlow gives you the same tools studios use for scheduling, clients, packages, payments and documents, so more of your week goes to teaching.
instructors.cta: Try it on your own schedule

blocks.title: Get found
blocks.body: Publish a public profile that can appear in Discover and take intro lesson requests from dancers looking for a teacher.

blocks.title: Teach
blocks.body: Keep private lessons and classes on one schedule, with confirmations and changes sent for you.

blocks.title: Keep students coming back
blocks.body: Track packages, take payment, collect signed waivers and send follow-up, with ARIA pointing out renewals and pending requests.

instructors.note: DanceFlow's plans are called studio plans. As an independent instructor you use the same plans and tools, and your workspace can carry your own teaching name.

organizers.headline: From event page to check-in, in one place.
organizers.support: Publish your event, sell tickets, welcome people with QR check-in and settle up afterward, for workshops, socials, showcases and festivals.
organizers.cta: See organizer pricing and start your trial

blocks.title: Publish
blocks.body: A public event page that can appear in Discover, with early bird pricing and optional guest coach private lesson slots.

blocks.title: Sell
blocks.body: Tickets with checkout, payment collection through Stripe, and a confirmation with a QR code for every buyer.

blocks.title: Check in
blocks.body: Scan ticket codes at the door and see who has arrived, then review attendance afterward.

blocks.title: Settle up
blocks.body: Closeout and settlement reports with financial summaries you can export.

organizers.note: Event pricing is shown in full before you create an account, including platform and payment processing fees.

dancers.headline: A public home for the dance community.
dancers.support: Find studios, events, dance partner listings and jobs in one place.

rows.title: Find a studio

rows.title: Discover events
rows.body: Socials, workshops, classes and special dance experiences.

rows.title: Dance partner listings
rows.body: Dancers looking for practice, social dancing or showcase partners.

rows.title: Dance work
rows.body: Instructor, coach, front-desk and event opportunities.

product.headline: The dance platform that helps do the work—not just track it.

event.support: Come see how DanceFlow helps studios, instructors and organizers run the business, and helps dancers find studios, events and dance partner listings.
